indications.pediatric_fixed: Use oral suspension for children

indications.title: Chancroid / Chlamydia Urethritis / Cervicitis
indications.adult_fixed: 1000 mg (1 gm) single oral dose
indications.pediatric_fixed: Adolescents >= 45 kg: 1000 mg single oral dose

indications.title: Uncomplicated Gonococcal Infection
indications.adult_fixed: 1 gm or 2 gm once in combination with Ceftriaxone 500 mg IM
indications.pediatric_fixed: Use under specialist guidance

indications.title: Chemoprophylaxis for High-risk Contacts of Meningococcal Disease
indications.adult_fixed: 500 mg single oral dose
indications.pediatric_fixed: Children >= 45 kg: 500 mg single oral dose

indications.title: Mycobacterium Avium Complex (MAC) Infection
indications.adult_fixed:
-Primary prophylaxis: 1200 mg once weekly (or 600 mg twice weekly)
-Treatment: 500-600 mg once daily + Ethambutol
-Suppression: 250 mg once daily
indications.pediatric_fixed: Use under specialist guidance

administration: Swallow with water with or without meals.
alternatives: Zithromax / Zithrokan / Azi-Once / Azrolid / Xithrone / Azomycin / Epizithro / Gigazocin / Unizithrin
search_terms: azi-once 250 cap azithromycin zithrokan zithromax azi-once azrolid xithrone macrolide antibiotic capsule 250 mg

indications.adult_fixed: 500 mg once daily for 3 days (OR 500 mg on Day 1, followed by 250 mg once daily on Days 2-5)
indications.pediatric_fixed: Tablets not recommended for small children (use oral suspension)
